parsed.name: Prior ProScan III 显微镜附件控制器
parsed.name_en: Prior ProScan III Microscope Accessory Controller
parsed.description: 用于显微镜系统的物理控制器，可管理连接到 ProScan III 的附件设备；从当前证据看，主要包括最多三个滤轮接口。它用于在实验中统一协调已连接滤轮等附件的通信与设备发现。
parsed.description_en: A physical controller for microscope systems that manages accessories connected to the ProScan III; based on the available evidence, this mainly includes up to three filter wheel connections. It is used in laboratory microscopy setups to coordinate communication with attached accessories and to discover managed devices.

actions.description: 自动发现并列出该控制器当前管理的已连接设备，例如滤轮。
actions.description_en: Automatically discover and list the devices currently managed by the controller, such as attached filter wheels.
